subject: Pilot-to-scale VPC commercial: smoothing platform fee & SRE response ladder
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@medlinkhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: MedLink Health Procurement <procurement@medlinkhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial for private VPC — packaging question

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the product demo yesterday — the team was encouraged by the latency numbers and the data isolation options. Procurement asked me to follow up on a couple of commercial points before we escalate to legal:

- For a 3-month pilot (single site, ~2m tokens/month) we need clarity on the platform fee amortization. Is Redwood able to smooth platform fees into monthly installments or offer a pilot credit against the platform fee if we convert to a 12-month private deployment?
- We also want a simplified SRE response ladder for pilots: 24x5 vs 24x7 and an explicit credit if SLOs are missed during the pilot window.
- Any constraints on using a subset of features (no streaming, limited model variants) to reduce cost during pilot?

We want to move quickly but need these items to land in the SOW and invoice schedule. Can you share an approach or a short example of how you'd structure the pilot accounting?

Appreciate it — cc'ing procurement for visibility.

Best,
Asha Patel
Head of Platform Integrations
MedLink Health

Attachment: MedLink_Pilot_Reqs.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@medlinkhealth.com>
Cc: MedLink Health Procurement <procurement@medlinkhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial for private VPC — packaging question

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear list. Below is a pragmatic path we typically use for pilot->scale conversions; happy to adjust for MedLink's procurement needs.

High-level pilot commercial options (3-month, single site):

1) Platform fee smoothing (recommended)
   - One-off platform fee (normally 3 months of platform entitlement) amortized across 12 months if customer signs a 12-month private deployment within 45 days of pilot end.
   - For pilots we invoice 50% of the platform fee up front + monthly usage. If you convert, we credit the 50% up to the amortized schedule; if you don't convert, that 50% converts to an extended trial credit for 6 months.

2) Pilot credit (alternative)
   - Redwood can offer a pilot credit equal to up to 40% of the platform fee contingent on a minimum annual commit (defined in SOW). Credit is applied to the first three invoices post-conversion.

SRE response ladder and credits
- Pilot SLOs: 24x5 coverage with 4-hour P1 response. If you opt into 24x7, we can enable an on-call add-on for an incremental monthly fee.
- Service credits: we propose a capped credit schedule (max 10% of monthly platform fee) tied to documented incidents that breach SLOs during the pilot.

Minimum features during pilot
- You may restrict to a single model family and disable streaming for the pilot. That will materially reduce usage costs; we will document feature gates in the SOW.

Next steps
- I'll attach a draft SOW template with the two commercialization options and an SRE tier table; can your procurement team indicate a preference (smoothing vs credit)?
- If you approve smoothing, we'll route a short amendment template that auto-applies the amortization on conversion.

I've attached a starter SOW and an SRE tiering spreadsheet for clarity.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MedLink_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf (stub), SRE_Tiering_Table.xlsx (stub)

Marissa / Asha — quick follow-up from SRE/procurement side.

On Thu, May 6, 2027 at 1:30 PM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Pilot SLOs: 24x5 coverage with 4-hour P1 response. If you opt into 24x7, we can enable an on-call add-on for an incremental monthly fee.
> - Service credits: we propose a capped credit schedule (max 10% of monthly platform fee) tied to documented incidents that breach SLOs during the pilot.

A couple of clarifications that would help us scope engineering support during the pilot:
- If MedLink elects the 24x7 add-on for the pilot window, that should be scoped as a temporary on-call augmentation (we add an on-call engineer plus rotations) — incremental pricing is usually X hours/week at $Y/hr. We can convert that into a simple monthly add-on line in the SOW.
- For the credit mechanics, procurement usually requests an objective metric (e.g., >300ms latency p95 or repeated unavailability windows). We can supply a short SLA appendix with measurable thresholds.

If you want, David can draft the SLA appendix and the amortization clause text so legal has something concrete to review.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Head of Customer Success, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

Marissa / Priya — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. Procurement reviewed both options with legal this morning and we prefer the smoothing route for commercial simplicity.

Asha's ask / summary:
- We accept the 50% up-front pilot platform fee with the amortization credit if we convert to a 12-month private deployment within 45 days.
- We will opt into 24x5 for the pilot; please include the explicit SRE appendix with objective thresholds for latency and availability.
- Please prepare a short SOW and invoice schedule showing the 50% up-front charge, monthly usage estimates, and the amortization clause. Procurement prefers Net30 terms on any pilot invoices.

Next steps for Redwood (requested by procurement)
1) David — can you produce a one-page SLA appendix and a sample invoice schedule (Net30) so we can circulate to finance?
2) Marissa — after David's appendix, send the SOW (PDF) and we can aim to sign a pilot SOW by 5/14.

Thanks again — looking forward to moving this into a signed SOW.

Best,
Asha Patel
Head of Platform Integrations
MedLink Health
